notes.scene: Friday, later-morning Bobby-only Skype; Dhika at home in swivel chair
notes.actors: Dhika and Bobby; only these two on call
notes.fact: E08 L209–210 repeats at L1–2. Dhika wheels away from camera, drops towel while her back faces Bobby, picks up bra and holds cups in place without securing straps or hooks; she turns back. Bobby privately prefers towel because its outline showed through, but only says towel looked better. Dhika decodes his unspoken implication, restores towel. She asks him to stand; shorts with visible clothed arousal enter frame, then she ends call to dress for errands and says Monday.
notes.char: Dhika knowingly engineers a back-only reveal and later tests Bobby's clothed response; still controls the call endpoint. Bobby remains shy but gains voice in comparing visual impressions; private thought is not spoken dialogue.
notes.rel: Remote Bobby route carries E08 cliffhanger forward; uncovered back is shown while front is turned away. Bra temporarily held, not secured; towel restored. No naked breast front-view is established.
notes.reader: E09 L1–2 replays E08 final two lines verbatim as overlap, not a second event. At L14 Bobby imagines the difference but leaves part unsaid; Dhika infers his intended meaning by L15.
notes.boundary: Bobby has limited back/covered-front sightline, not unlimited permission. Her request that he stand and observed clothed arousal do not authorize further contact; she closes call.
notes.author: Maintain frame geometry: swivel-chair back to camera at towel-drop, handheld bra only then front to camera, towel restored before Bobby stands. Friday certainty is supplied L27.

notes.scene: Friday mall top-floor food court; Saturday dinner invitation
notes.actors: Dhika, John, Sharmi, Raj; Pappu and Aunty dropped at park
notes.fact: Friday John signs off early; couple drops Pappu/Aunty at park and visits mall. Dhika receives her usual donut. They unexpectedly meet Sharmi and Raj, who are waiting for ice cream before a film. All greet warmly; when Sharmi hugs John and others watch Dhika greet Raj, she blushes and chooses awkward handshake. Raj helps defuse joke, invites the couple to dinner at his home Saturday. Both agree and resume shopping.
notes.char: Dhika is affectionate with Sharmi but reserved toward Raj despite friendly pressure; John and Sharmi's playful teasing highlights her social hesitation. Raj consistently courteous.
notes.rel: Sharmi↔John hug and wink; Dhika↔Raj handshake only. Raj↔John mutual polite hug. Dinner invitation accepted; no romantic inference from public greetings.
notes.reader: Social pressure on Dhika is witnessed by everyone; John's grin motive and Sharmi wink remain teasing rather than evidence of marital permission or affair.
notes.boundary: Dhika chooses handshake despite laughs; nobody is entitled to demand she hug Raj. Sharmi's public wink cannot prove John intent.
notes.author: Food-court geography and order of greetings matter; Saturday dinner invitation planted. Distinguish Friday donut/mall from Saturday grocery delivery and night dinner.

notes.scene: Saturday at home: family morning, Maami order, Chotu delivery
notes.actors: Dhika, John, Pappu (family); Maami by call, then Chotu
notes.fact: After usual family morning, John leaves for errands around 11 and Pappu sleeps. Dhika orders supermarket-missing goods from Maami, primarily hoping Chotu will deliver them. After ~30 minutes Chotu comes, avoids eye contact, looks dull and has tears. Dhika kneels, lifts his chin and brings him to sofa; she asks what happened. Chotu begins 'last time'; Dhika asks whether she hurt him.
notes.char: Dhika actively creates opportunity to reconnect with Chotu but initially does not know cause of tears. Chotu remains distressed until he speaks; E07 distance is now observable in person.
notes.rel: E06 unresolved physical/consent aftermath and E07 distance are actively revisited, but no resolution is proven before his answer in P4.
notes.reader: Do not confuse Dhika's prior speculation for verified Chotu explanation until his own words at L74 onward. Pappu's breastfeeding/nap and John errands are ordinary family context, not part of adult pair analysis.
notes.boundary: Dhika initiates chin support, hands and sofa guidance as comfort; crying does not automatically imply forgiveness or consent for later gestures.
notes.author: Keep Chotu delivery props and schedule: Saturday after ~11 a.m.; John temporarily away; Pappu sleeping in bedroom. E06 stop requests persist in predecessor history.

notes.scene: Saturday Dhika–Chotu private reconciliation and painting-clothes gift
notes.fact: Chotu says he feels guilty because last time he could not control himself despite respecting and loving Dhika. She says she has not changed, reassures him, and suggests if anything responsibility is hers; he says no. She insists he smile, joking she will withhold payment for goods, kisses his forehead, then gives two shorts, two flower-print vests for painting and a separate full-sleeve T-shirt gift. He hugs her voluntarily. They discuss families and she asks him to promise never to cry about this again.
notes.char: Chotu directly supplies his reason for avoidance: his own shame. He moves from tears to a faint smile and later a hug. Dhika mixes sincere reassurance, affection, material care and playful payment joke.
notes.rel: Previously unresolved Chotu emotional distance receives verbal repair and voluntary hug; however she says 'nothing wrong' as her own appraisal, which does NOT delete E06 recorded stop requests and ignored refusals.
notes.reader: Chotu's stated guilt is direct E09 evidence; Dhika's reassurance does not demonstrate she has processed all prior boundary violations. Painting shorts/vests are practical, T-shirt separately a gift.
notes.boundary: No explicit debrief of E06 ignored stop requests; do not mark past consent issue resolved. Chotu's promise not to cry is emotional, not waiver of boundaries.
notes.author: Track clothes precisely: Dhika shorts + black full-sleeve top + ponytail during this visit. Gift inventory: two cotton shorts, two printed vests, one full-sleeve T-shirt.

notes.scene: Saturday continuation at sofa; kiss-history question and new kiss
notes.fact: Dhika jokes about a previous kiss, prompting Chotu to ask how it felt. Her initial silence is genuine because she has not evaluated it; he interprets it negatively. She remembers a previous soft peck and reciprocal kiss, thinks it was 'cute'. Seeing him lying on sofa, she kneels, wraps arms around his head and initiates a firm three-second lip kiss; Chotu blinks, surprised but lightly smiles. She then answers that the earlier kiss was cute.
notes.char: Dhika deliberately revisits an earlier memory and gives her answer through a new present action. Chotu is initially vulnerable to rejection, then surprised/pleased in observed reaction.
notes.rel: An earlier lip-kiss event is referenced in E09 retrospective narration; do not force it into an unverified predecessor Part if not located. E09 P5 contains a NEW Dhika-initiated lip kiss, not merely recollection.
notes.reader: Source says previous first kiss was reciprocal and a soft peck in memory; current P5 kiss is described concretely as held ~3 seconds. Chotu had not pre-requested this new kiss.
notes.boundary: Surprise/light smile after the kiss is observed, but cannot be generalized into blanket consent or resolution of E06 unrelated stop requests.
notes.author: Distinguish retrospectively remembered prior kiss versus newly initiated E09 kiss. Maintain point-of-view and sofa mirrored posture; exact previous source pointer requires independent verification.

notes.scene: Saturday around 6 p.m., couple preparing and driving to Raj–Sharmi home
notes.fact: John/Pappu wait for Dhika to dress. She first comes out in saree; John jokes she always looks dressed for temple/college, and she angrily returns to bedroom. About 20 minutes later she emerges in an outfit she has never worn before or worn outside; John is impressed but she teasingly refuses his praise. She drives the family Octavia because Pappu sits on John. They arrive at Raj's large three-floor house; Dhika spots Mini Cooper and BMW GT in garage.
notes.char: Dhika responds to John teasing by deliberately changing presentation rather than passively accepting the joke; enjoys rare chance to drive.
notes.rel: Marriage teasing is affectionate but her initial anger is real within playful sequence; no permission/interest in Raj is proven merely because she changes for dinner there.
notes.reader: Exact white sleeveless shift dress details are supplied later at L159, not at initial exit. Avoid importing later camera knowledge prematurely if reviewing P6 in isolation.
notes.boundary: John's joke prompts a clothing choice; not a license to coerce her presentation. Pappu is simply sleepy and in father's arms.
notes.author: Track saree→new white shift dress change, ~20-min delay and ~20-min car ride. Source says Raj house recently occupied, not all floors finished.

notes.scene: Saturday evening Raj–Sharmi foyer and hall
notes.actors: Dhika, John, Sharmi, Raj; sleeping Pappu moved to guest bedroom
notes.fact: Sharmi welcomes them and comments on Dhika's unusual modern dress; Dhika refers to proving John wrong. Sharmi takes John to settle sleeping Pappu in ground-floor guest bedroom. Raj comes downstairs in cargo pants/white linen shirt and stops mid-greeting, visibly struck by Dhika's white sleeveless fitted shift dress, hair curls and dark-rose lipstick. All laugh about her first public outing in it. Sharmi continues holding John's arm and sits with him on a two-seater, so Dhika sits alone while Raj takes another two-seater.
notes.char: Dhika experiences new public attention and blushes; Raj polite compliment rather than physical advance. Sharmi is direct/playfully territorial in seating and teasing, John joins joking.
notes.rel: Sharmi↔John arm holding and shared sofa; Dhika initially hopes to sit with husband but gets single seat, Raj sits separately. No one-on-one intimate Raj contact in P7.
notes.reader: Clothing continuity: Dhika white sleeveless shift, above knees; Sharmi black narrow-strap dress. Raj's source L155 has stray 'X'/speaker wording irregularity; preserve ambiguity in QA.
notes.boundary: Raj looking at dress isn't proof of romantic proposal. Sharmi's choice to hold John's arm is observable, not marriage change.
notes.author: Map foyer, ground guest bedroom, stair landing, two double sofas + one single; Pappu sleeps without witnessing adult conversation.

notes.scene: Saturday evening Raj house backyard tour
notes.fact: Dhika admires house; John calls Raj rich and modest, Sharmi counters his spending. Sharmi pulls John toward back door to show the yard, but Dhika rushes onto golden-lit lawn first. John admires built-in patio barbecue. Raj explains unfinished pool hole and plans for game room, shower room and other spaces on second floor. John jokes he'll move in once completed; Sharmi warmly plays along before all return inside.
notes.char: Dhika's enthusiasm is about illuminated outdoor ambience; John enjoys barbecue, Raj enjoys house design and joking, Sharmi teasing about cost and John.
notes.rel: No new private intimacy; friendly four-person outdoor tour with playful house/join-us language. Sharmi's joke doesn't create literal John living arrangement.
notes.reader: Pool is unfinished hole, not operational. Second-floor rooms remain planned, not built; future scene writers must not treat them as ready.
notes.boundary: Touch: Sharmi pulls John toward back door, witnessed group action. No Raj–Dhika touch in this Part.
notes.author: Property geometry: paved/golden-lit lawn, built-in barbecue on patio, incomplete pool excavation, unfinished second-floor rooms.

notes.scene: Saturday evening indoors, wine then tea/kitchen and group dinner
notes.fact: Sharmi pours wine for four but Dhika declines because she does not drink; Raj also declines to accompany her. John/Sharmi take wine and chat/flirt by sofa while Raj insists on making tea for Dhika. He cracks jokes in kitchen; she laughs and feels impressed, privately comparing his cooking to John's hot-water-only skill. On return Dhika voluntarily sits beside Raj, but less close than Sharmi is to John; John sees this and raises his eyebrows. Group dinner follows.
notes.char: Dhika values Raj's hospitality/humour and becomes more comfortable with him; Raj considerate and funny. John notes sounds from kitchen but is busy receiving Sharmi's flirt.
notes.rel: Dhika↔Raj new friendly one-on-one kitchen conversation and closer seating; John↔Sharmi continued flirt/social proximity. No private kiss or affair established.
notes.reader: Raj choosing tea may be courtesy, not documented romantic motive. Narrator says Dhika feels closer, but not a confirmed romantic relationship.
notes.boundary: Dhika's no-wine choice is respected; closer seating does not consent to touch. Wine glasses belong John/Sharmi only.
notes.author: Separate witness states: John hears kitchen giggles but does not hear their full conversation; pairing on sofas changes from P7.

notes.scene: Saturday late dinner and departure; Sunday 10 p.m. horror movie plan
notes.actors: Dhika, John, Sharmi, Raj; sleeping Pappu
notes.fact: They discuss Raj's planned home theatre and horror-film enthusiasm. Raj invites them to new horror film tomorrow, Sharmi encourages knowing Dhika fears horror, John mentions that fear; Raj jokes he will protect her from ghosts. Dhika accepts, and they settle Sunday 10 p.m. On departing, John and Raj exchange light hug; Sharmi hugs John tightly and winks. Raj expects handshake but Dhika spontaneously gives him a light farewell hug. Everyone notices and Sharmi teases.
notes.char: Dhika accepts film despite fear and chooses a new Raj hug of her own accord, moving beyond Friday handshake. Sharmi shows public teasing and stronger John hug. Raj appears surprised by Dhika's shift.
notes.rel: Dhika↔Raj greeting boundary progresses from Friday handshake to Saturday voluntary light hug. Sharmi↔John prolonged/tight goodbye hug also observed, but no affair or partner-swapping confirmed.
notes.reader: Sunday 10 p.m. is a plan, not a completed movie visit inside E09; Pappu sleeping remains ordinary family continuity.
notes.boundary: Raj initially moves for handshake; Dhika initiates hug rather than being pressured to it this time. Voluntary hug is narrow, not unrestricted access.
notes.author: Sequence: dinner→movie invite accepted→Sunday 10 p.m. plan→Pappu carry→John/Raj light hug→Sharmi/John tight hug→Dhika/Raj light hug.

notes.scene: Saturday late return home by car
notes.actors: Dhika and John; Sharmi/Raj referred to; Pappu asleep
notes.fact: John lightly teases Dhika for hugging Raj, noting she seldom hugs strangers. Dhika says Raj is Sharmi's husband and gentleman, counters by teasing John about wine/Sharmi's flirting. John jokes Sharmi can 'keep' him but he'll always return to Dhika. She mock-hits him then kisses him. They continue reciprocal teasing about Raj and Sharmi all the way home.
notes.char: Dhika is assertive in defending her voluntary social hug and playful about Sharmi's crush; John answers with affectionate reassurance. Marital interaction remains active and reciprocal.
notes.rel: Dhika↔John playful jealousy and kiss; no confession about Chotu, Bobby or Bantu. New Raj social familiarity does not become a confirmed affair.
notes.reader: A reported 'crush' on John is Dhika's teasing description of Sharmi, not verified admission from Sharmi. John's 'can keep me' is playful conditional banter, not relationship authorization.
notes.boundary: Marriage joke/kiss demonstrates affection but no evidence of open relationship, affair permission, new secrecy disclosure or changed exclusivity terms.
notes.author: E09 hard stop: ends on car teasing, before Sunday planned 10 p.m. movie; do not narrate E10 outcomes into E09.
